= callout-positions(1)
:doctype: manpage
:revdate: 2026-10-05
:source-highlighter: syntect

== Name

callout-positions - preserve callout placement

== Synopsis

Callout position controls.

== Description

[source,xml]
----
<tag>C01 & "é中"</tag> <!--1-->
<tag>C02</tag><!--2-->
<tag>C03</tag> <!--3--> <!--4-->
<tag>C04</tag> <!--5--><!--6-->
----
<1> XML guard.
<2> No preceding space.
<3> First spaced guard.
<4> Second spaced guard.
<5> First adjacent guard.
<6> Second adjacent guard.

[source,rust]
----
C05(); <1> <2>
C06(); <3><4>
C07(); <5> <5>
C08();    <6>
C09(); // <7> <8>
----
<1> First marker.
<2> Second marker.
<3> First adjacent marker.
<4> Second adjacent marker.
<5> Repeated marker.
<6> Authored spaces.
<7> First guarded marker.
<8> Second guarded marker.

[source,xml]
----
<tag>C10</tag> <!--.--><!--.-->
----
<.> First automatic marker.
<.> Second automatic marker.

[source,xml]
----
<tag>C11</tag> \<!--1-->
<tag>C12</tag> <!--1--> suffix
<tag>C13</tag> <!-- ordinary comment -->
----

[source,unknown-language]
----
C14 é中 & "text" <1> <2>
----
<1> Unknown language.
<2> Last marker at EOF.

[source,text,linenums,start=7,highlight="7,9"]
----
<1>
C15
<2><3>
----
<1> Marker-only first line.
<2> Marker-only last line.
<3> Adjacent final marker.

[source,text,linenums,start=20,highlight=20]
----
<1>
----
<1> Marker-only block.
